name: Tomb Raider: Lost and Found
storyline: In "Tomb Raider: Lost and Found", you will follow Lara on her first adventure as she sets out to find the legendary Philosopher's Stone. Journey through the vast sands of Saudi Arabia in search of the long-lost Iram of the Pillars and its mysterious secrets. Uncover the remnants of the ancient world and locate the Mercury Stone.
summary: Lost and Found expands the lore behind one of Lara’s first adventures. Find documents all throughout the game to learn more about Lara’s backstory, as well as the history behind the Lost City of Iram.
